crossRefs.note: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make Yahweh’s people disobey.
But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of…
but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge…
“Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person…
Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom…
It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob.
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…

translations.web: If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
translations.bsb: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.
translations.kjv: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
translations.asv: If I had said, I will speak thus; Behold, I had dealt treacherously with the generation of thy children.
